# Game Night: A Minecraft Server {#sec-minecraft-server}

{{< credits 08-minecraft-server >}}

::: {.callout-important}
## Draft
This chapter is an outline. Want to help write it? Start with @sec-your-first-contribution.
:::

## Goal

Run a server that friends and family can join from their own houses.

## The big idea

Ports, port forwarding, server resources (RAM and CPU), and hosting something other people depend on.

## Outline

- Java vs Bedrock, and which one your players use
- Running the server in a container
- Ports: why the game needs port 25565 and what that number means
- Before you open it: whitelist on, online-mode on, server updated
- Port forwarding hands-on: forward 25565 so friends can join
- Verify it works from outside the house
- RAM and CPU: watching resources while players join
- Server settings, whitelists and ops
- Mods and modpacks as a stretch goal
- World backups before anything risky

::: {.callout-warning}
## Break it on purpose
Give the server too little RAM and watch it lag, then tune it.
:::
